resources.string: One-time setup. Easiest way is the code: enter your WhatsApp number and you get 8 characters to type into WhatsApp — no second phone needed to scan a QR.
Whenever a repo gets a new release, the bot posts it to your WhatsApp channel or group. More than one repo is fine, separate them with commas. Leave the repo empty if you only want the group guard.
No repos yet. Tap Manage repos to add one.
Beta / RC versions get posted too
On first run, post the latest release right away
Send a test message during setup
So you know the channel is right

Release posts are sent with WhatsApp\'s official Question flag — followers can reply straight to the admins. If a phone doesn\'t recognize the format yet, the post still shows up as plain text that always arrives. Off by default.

For groups that use "Approve new members": join requests get approved automatically, EXCEPT people who left or were removed before — they get rejected. Your WhatsApp account must be an admin of that group.
People who left BEFORE this feature was on are unknown to the bot — add their numbers here.

Opt-in and off by default. Enable only for audio you have the right to use; public-channel snippets can still trigger copyright claims or provider-policy issues. Cloudflare finds audio, the phone sends a ~60-second snippet, then deletes it.
Sent to the same channel as releases
Trusted code only. Projects run inside the same app sandbox and can read the WhatsApp session and private settings. Every ZIP shows its SHA-256 and requires confirmation before installation.
The bot sleeps most of the time and only wakes briefly on schedule. To keep the system (especially Xiaomi) from killing it, allow the two things below.
No need to open the app after a restart
Turn off once everything runs smoothly — saves a bit
App and engine logs are always recorded. Enable Android logcat here; Download all logs to save a copy. Logs may contain phone numbers or links—review before sharing.
Includes Android logcat and Node output; app and engine logs remain on.
The bot won\'t start. Check the settings (repo/channel) and the Log card.
The engine hasn\'t answered the pause command. Try again, or stop the service.
The service hasn\'t stopped yet. Try again.
Repo list is empty — the bot watches nothing until you add a repo.
All logs saved to a ZIP file.
There are no log files to save yet.
%1$s v%2$s (%3$s)\nPersonal bot: GitHub releases → WhatsApp channel, group guard, mood songs, bot hosting.\nLicense: personal use — no selling or redistribution without permission.
No browser to open the link.
The bot can\'t post or guard groups until it\'s linked again. The device also disappears from Linked devices on your phone.
Sending a test message to the channel… the result shows up in the Log card.
Fill in the group invite link first.
Sending a test message to the group… the result shows up in the Log card.
The bot creates a WhatsApp channel under your account and starts posting there. Already have a channel? Just paste its link in the WhatsApp channel field.
Everyone the bot recorded for leaving can be approved again. Numbers you typed manually are not removed.
Fill in the WhatsApp channel first — that\'s where songs go.
Taking a song from the queue and sending it to the channel… the result shows up in the Log card.
The Node process and all schedules stop until you tap Start again (or the phone restarts, if autostart is on).
Group guard is on, but the group link is empty.
Add a GitHub repo, turn on group guard, or turn on mood songs — at least one.
Saved. The channel is still empty — paste a channel link or tap Create channel.
Enter your WhatsApp number first (the one the bot will use), e.g. 0812 3456 7890.
The service is taking too long. Try again, or check the log.
Service not ready yet — try again in a moment.
Battery optimization: exempted. Android won\'t put this bot to sleep.
Battery optimization: still ON. The system may sleep or kill the bot when the screen is off. Tap the button above.
✓ Bot running. Releases are checked on schedule.
⏸ Bot paused — schedules stopped, the service stays on.
⏻ Service stopped. The bot is fully off until you tap Start.
WhatsApp linked! The bot is ready.
Linking WhatsApp failed — the reason is in the Log card.
The service is off — tap Start to turn it on.
Off. Turn on the switch, then Save.
Next song in about %1$s (time is randomized)
Waiting for the bot to run…
Today\'s quota from the server: %1$s (resets at midnight UTC)
All set, nothing else to do. Want to change the number? Unlink first, then link again.
✓ WhatsApp linked%1$s — the bot is ready.

1. Open WhatsApp on the phone with the number %1$s
2. Three dots ⋮ → Linked devices → Link a device
3. Choose "Link with phone number instead" (below the camera)
4. Type the code below

WhatsApp usually also sends an "enter code" notification — just tap it.
Couldn\'t draw the QR — try the code instead.

From ANOTHER phone that has WhatsApp: ⋮ → Linked devices → Link a device, then point the camera here. The QR refreshes every ±20 seconds.\n\nBot on the same phone as WhatsApp? Close this and use \"Link with code\".
%1$s can join again (approved on the next check).
Blocked manually (field \"Always reject these numbers\"): %1$s\nTo unblock these, remove the number from that field and Save.
People who left or were removed from the group. If they ask to join again they\'re rejected automatically — unless you unblock them here.
Find \"WA Release Bot\" and turn it on.
No vendor Autostart menu found. In App info, check the Battery / Autostart section.

Or use the Send log button.
The log folder can\'t be read.
Couldn\'t prepare the log files for sending.
WhatsApp isn\'t on this phone — type the code on the phone that has WhatsApp.
error, open to see the console
Watched repos and the target channel of each
empty = use the main WhatsApp channel
Adding a repo that is already listed replaces its channel. A channel can be a channel link, a group link, or a JID.
No repos yet. Fill in the form above, then tap Add.
Changes are saved automatically and sent to the bot when you return to the main screen. Stored in the same format as the CLI: owner/a|channel-link, owner/b.
Enter the repo first, e.g. xykal/wa-release-bot
Wrong repo format. Correct example: owner/repo-name
Run your own Node.js bot project on this phone
Installing modules from npm… progress is in the console.
Type input for the bot (e.g. a WhatsApp number)…

The ZIP holds package.json + the main file (index.js / \"main\" / start script). node_modules is optional — if missing, the app installs from npm (native packages like sharp won\'t work). A .env file is read too. Bundled runtime: Node 18 — it only changes with an APK update.
The bot is stopped and all project files (including that bot\'s WhatsApp session & node_modules) are deleted from the phone.
The ZIP is larger than 100 MB. Remove node_modules/cache from the archive and try again.
package.json not found in the ZIP
The service isn\'t running yet. Try again.
%1$s of %2$s attempts failed. The bot stops retrying until you tap \"Check now\".\n%3$s
Shown when a release could not be sent to the channel after the last attempt
New release, straight to the channel
Every new GitHub release is announced to your WhatsApp channel automatically. You just keep coding.
Join requests are approved automatically. Someone who left or got kicked before? The bot rejects them, no babysitting needed.
Old songs, when the mood hits
Now and then the bot posts a snippet of an old song with a neat caption to the channel. No spam — only when the mood hits.
Have your own bot project? Upload the ZIP and this app runs it. Logs, input, restart — all from the phone.

ZIP code runs inside the same sandbox as WA Release Bot. Malicious code can read the WhatsApp session, GitHub token, settings, and private app files. Run only projects you have audited.

ZIP SHA-256:
%1$s

The hash identifies only the selected archive; retained .env, session, and node_modules files are not covered.
XyVerse Technology Global splash voice over: once after install, respects silent mode.
Plays once on the first open after install, then stays off. Switch on to hear it again.
RAM, architecture, Android version, storage, permissions. Below minimum the bot still runs, just with warnings.
Device below ideal spec: %1$s warning(s). Details in the Device check card.
Device check written to the log.
The core feature lives in the Repo tab. Every extra below is opt-in and off on a fresh install. Features marked experimental are not yet part of the stable public-release promise.
Off by default. Group moderation and personal commands keep WhatsApp connected, use more battery, and still require real-device validation.

Messages with outside links, promos/sales pitches, gambling, or banned words are deleted right away; the sender gets 1 warning (tagged), then is removed on the last strike. Admins and the bot itself are never touched.
Personal commands in your own chat
.menu .ping .status .sticker .story .group — only in your own chat, never in groups.
When on, links other than the blocked domains are not deleted.
Added on top of the built-in list — e.g. selling terms: pre-order, ready stock, COD, DM for price, order via WA (comma or newline)
Sending to your own chat (the result shows when it finishes).
Send your own message to the monitored group, e.g. the blacklist every 12 hours. Each send opens WhatsApp once, so it stays battery friendly.
Requires the group guard to be on: that group is the destination.
e.g. Group rules: no links (separate with new lines)
Periodic message sent now (when WhatsApp is connected).
Periodic message every %1$s h | last: %2$s | total %3$s | next: %4$s
Periodic messages need the group guard on: that group is the destination. Turn it on in the group guard card first.
When on: the message box below is ignored, only the group blacklist is sent.
